summary.text: Ian Schwartz is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 62, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
A U.S. Air Force veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign focuses on household costs including property tax relief, healthcare access, and public safety and emergency services.

paragraphs.text: Ian Schwartz served in the U.S. Air Force from 2007 to 2011.

He earned a high school diploma from Bloomsburg Area High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Cincinnati in 2016, and a graduate degree from Salmon P. Chase College of Law at Northern Kentucky University in 2023.
Ballotpedia lists him as retired as of 2026.

Schwartz said in a Ballotpedia survey that he served on a Tactical Response Force in the Air Force and decided to run because he believes regular people deserve representation that understands their challenges.

He listed three key messages: supporting policies that stabilize costs and provide property tax relief; protecting healthcare access and working to control prescription drug and insurance costs; and supporting police, fire and EMS services, family farms and local food access.
He also named education as a priority, saying schools should be properly funded and higher education should remain affordable.
